focus: Path containment and untrusted input across the epic: generate-leaf-manifest.cjs symlink and git-ignore handling, hook stdin readers (unbounded input, JSON parse of partial input), the Webflow runtime check fix 82d297a374, and drift-guard or checker scripts that shell out with interpolated paths (security)

findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the host runtime is the only stdin writer and already holds the payload, so a cap belongs to the host
findingDetails.claim: readStdin accumulates unbounded bytes into memory; only time (the deadline) is bounded
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the reader and its test for a cap constant or truncation path; checked every call site for a cap argument (only timeoutMs is destructured)
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a documented host-side payload bound, or a caller passing a byte cap into this reader
findingDetails.title: Shared CJS stdin reader buffers without a byte cap; the deadline bounds time, not memory

findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the check is deliberately POSIX-only because authored aliases are POSIX, but nothing states that and the sibling validator in the same file handles Windows forms
findingDetails.claim: the alias diskPath check does not enforce the containment it advertises for Windows path forms
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether diskPath can reach the filesystem (it cannot) and whether alias leafResourceIds have their own containment (they do: assertContainment)
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: proof that alias files are normalized before this check or a contract note declaring diskPath POSIX-only
findingDetails.title: Alias diskPath containment check misses backslash traversal and drive-letter forms the sibling scope validator rejects

findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: callbacks beyond the cap are only reachable by endless pollers that cannot error, so the blind spot is unreachable
findingDetails.claim: a callback error that fires after 20 nested synchronous callbacks is never recorded and the file reports PASS
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the cap records a diagnostic when hit, whether deeper chains can no longer schedule, and whether the fix documents the boundary in the contract
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a demonstration that no reachable callback chain can carry an error past depth 20, or a checker note accepting the depth bound
findingDetails.title: Webflow runtime check silently drops callbacks past depth 20: a deferred crash beyond the cap still reports PASS

noveltyJustification: First security pass over the four named surfaces; live stdin probes and fixture execution produced evidence no prior iteration recorded, and two findings sit in files never reviewed in iterations 2-4.

searchLedger.hypothesis: the shared reader can be made to buffer unbounded bytes within its deadline

searchActions.result: chunks.push with no cap; only timeoutMs is configurable

searchActions.queryOrPath: node probe: held-open stdin, timeoutMs=1000; then head -c 30000000 /dev/zero into the reader
searchActions.result: deadline resolved at 1002 ms with 6 bytes; 30,000,000 bytes accepted whole

searchLedger.rationale: no cap exists and the probe shows the buffer growing to the writer's size

searchLedger.invariant: a deadline-truncated payload must not be mistaken for a security-relevant decision input

searchActions.result: parseJsonFailOpen returns null on any parse failure
bytes=6 json=null at the deadline; fail-open is the documented adapter contract

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: fail-open on partial input is the adapter's stated contract and was already ruled out in iteration 2; no blocking gate depends on the truncated-bytes case for an enforcement boundary

searchLedger.hypothesis: authored alias diskPaths can carry traversal or absolute forms past the containment gate

searchActions.result: raw-string check: startsWith('/') or a literal '..' segment only

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg diskPath over sk-create-skill scripts + lib
searchActions.result: string-match consumer (resolveSharedAlias) plus identity rows; no filesystem read

searchLedger.rationale: backslash and drive-letter forms pass; the sibling scope validator rejects the same shapes

searchLedger.invariant: no symlink may let the walker enumerate or the writer overwrite a path outside the skill root

searchActions.result: realpath prefix containment for roots and leaf links; atomic O_EXCL temp + rename; symlink manifest refused

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: walker and writer contain or refuse every symlink case found by direct read

searchLedger.hypothesis: an interpolated path reaches a shell in a drift guard or checker

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg execSync|spawnSync|spawn|execFileSync over the four focus trees
searchActions.result: all call sites pass argv arrays; no shell:true anywhere
set -euo pipefail; every expansion quoted; roots derived from BASH_SOURCE

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: no shell interpolation of paths exists at any call site; python and node guards resolve roots from their own file location
searchLedger.rationale: the named risk is not present

searchLedger.hypothesis: the runtime check can report PASS for a script whose deferred error is not observed

searchActions.result: callback errors recorded only while depth < 20; the cap returns silently
MAX_SYNC_CALLBACK_DEPTH and the silent return were added by the reviewed fix

searchActions.queryOrPath: node ../../test-minified-runtime.mjs from known-bad and known-good fixture roots
searchActions.result: Failed: 4/4 with the Do-not-deploy line; Passed: 2/2

searchLedger.rationale: silent truncation makes a false PASS indistinguishable from a clean run

searchLedger.hypothesis: a non-work-tree run enumerates locally ignored files into the committed manifest

searchActions.result: fallback drops only __pycache__, node_modules, .DS_Store and .pyc; a dot file is otherwise a leaf candidate

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: the manifest carries path names only, the fallback is deliberate and documented, and git-backed repos are covered by check-ignore
searchLedger.rationale: recorded as edge case 2 rather than a finding
